page.layout: One printed page of text, one column, with a heading at the top; a fragment of the neighbouring page's text in the left margin (cut off, not transcribed as text). No notes in the right margin; no page number or running head printed. Digitiser's banner below the page is not transcribed.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.

p.i: Nunc animis opus est, omni nunc arte ministrâ.

main_text.p: Hic Animus, hæc Ars, gemina sunt familiæ tuæ insignia: Ex qua nuper, ut antiqua silentio præteream, affulsit decus illud Patriæ, Pater tuus, D. Cornelius Staefvenisse, illustr. & Præpot. Ordinum Zelandiæ Consiliarius & Syndicus, vir in gravissimis Reipublicæ negotiis exercitatus, & extraordinariis ad moderatores exterarum gentium, no-

page.notes: The left-margin fragments are the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Some words in the text are faint; "Staefvenisse" reads as printed ("Zelandiæ" with Ę-like letter rendered as Z). The line "no-" is a catchword-like hyphenated line end continuing on the next page; a small mark appears beneath it, not transcribed as a catchword.
